model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (claude -p, no tools; first run's agent could not read its file)

other: dropped the detail that file-system access requires random location indices
pairs.notes: The list number 2 is in both. 'hash tables' -> 'hash maps', 'generally' -> 'typically' and 'much faster' -> 'significantly quicker' are equivalent, so they are left out. 'every file or page' matches 'all files/pages'.
Only paraphrase: 'corporate world' -> 'business setting', 'eye-opening' -> 'transformative', 'overwhelmed' -> 'felt a mix'. Left out because none of these clearly changes the facts.

quantifiers: bees have long taken their flights -> bees are about to migrate
other: direction flipped: flights south to warmer climates -> migration northward towards cooler regions
time changed: close to noon -> afternoon, sun beginning to set
flights already long taken (today) -> flights about to begin, described as annual
added claim that the measure is essential to biodiversity and ecosystem health
pairs.notes: The original is garbled. The rewrite reverses direction and climate and adds a new claim. There is no negation.

other: 'contener' (contain) the most dangerous fires -> 'evitar' (avoid/prevent) them
pairs.notes: 2013 is in both. 'servicios de protección civil' -> 'servicios de emergencias' is a generic wording, not a clear change of organisation, so it is left out. 'datos definitivos' -> 'resultados oficiales', 'imprudencias' -> 'errores' and 'negligencias' -> 'omisiones' are close synonyms. 'casi exclusivamente' -> 'casi toda' is about the same strength.

quantifiers: difficile da dimenticare -> quasi impossibile da dimenticare
prova di stile -> assoluto prova di stile (intensifier added)
other: 'libro' (book) -> 'manuale' (manual), a different kind of work, in the opening and in the first sentence
critica 'insolita e divertente' -> 'straordinaria e piacevole' (stronger praise)
critica di lingua inglese -> critica inglese (English-language critics -> English critics)
'sorpresa' (surprise) -> 'emozione' (emotion)
'ironia' -> 'scherzo' (irony -> joke)
pairs.notes: Interrogative Mood, Padgett Powell and Guanda are in both. 'quasi ossessiva' -> 'pressoché ossessiva' and 'soltanto' -> 'esclusivamente' are equivalent. Some of the lexical drift (emozione, scherzo) is borderline.

other: the stall's name 'Eternal Noodle Dream' became a generic 'enduring noodle fantasy'
'distant childhood sunsets' -> 'far-off, beautiful sunsets' (childhood dropped, 'beautiful' added)
'between tables' dropped
pairs.notes: Phoenixville is in both. 'not merely' -> 'isn't just' is the same polarity. The original ends abruptly ('only hint') and the rewrite completes it as 'a gentle, subtle suggestion'; I treated that as equivalent.

other: the rewrite is in English, but the original is in Spanish (translation, not a rewrite)
pairs.notes: The content matches: protection systems, preventing the spread of faults, faster response than circuit breakers, manual replacement needed. Only the language changed.

other: added claim: the shift brought a new level of appreciation and creativity to the kitchen
added claim: a friend introduced a new flavor to the table
dropped that the speaker 'went back home' for the classes and that 'new friends joined us'
'lack of seasoning or skill' -> 'lack of preparation skills' (seasoning dropped)
'it won't be pretty' (future or hypothetical) -> 'it didn't go as planned' (stated as past fact)
'something has rippled through me' -> 'a profound change occurred within the realm of cooking classes'
pairs.notes: 'It wasn't me but last year' -> 'It was not I; it was last year' is the same meaning, so no flip. 'never should've happened' and 'shouldn't have been the case' keep the same polarity.

other: the rewrite is in English, but the original is in Spanish (translation, not a rewrite)
'equipos mejor clasificados enfrentándose en cuartos...' -> 'top teams advancing to the quarterfinals...' (slightly different framing)
pairs.notes: 16 teams, Japan, Australia, the group stage in the first week and the two-leg knockout phase are all in both. Japan and Australia are translated names, not changes.

other: subject changed: the keys' size -> the values' length
'hash functions' -> 'mapping functions' (technical term lost)
'bucket' -> 'group slot'
'Memory Efficiency' -> 'Space Efficiency'
pairs.notes: The list number 4 is in both. 'does not determine' -> 'does not affects' keeps the negation. 'many' and 'most' are unchanged. The grammar of the rewrite is broken, but the meaning is roughly the same apart from the key/value swap.
